nom: Mario Badescu Drying Lotion Blemish Spot Treatment

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the product effectively dries out whiteheads and pimples overnight, including a husband and teenage daughter both described as having oily, acne-prone skin.
segments.dry: A reviewer describing dry, mature skin reports it still resolves occasional breakouts and doubles as a mosquito-bite treatment.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports it treats deep under-the-skin pimples without leaving the face oily afterward.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer identifying as having sensitive skin reports the product works well but notes that overuse can trigger irritation due to its strength.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 70s describe using it for adult or hormonal acne that appeared later in life, generally reporting breakouts calm down within days.

concerns.aging: Only mentioned incidentally by older reviewers (30s–70s) coping with unexpected adult acne rather than wrinkles or firmness; no direct anti-aging effect is reported.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers note the product is drying and require moisturizing afterward to avoid over-drying skin; one reviewer with dry mature skin still tolerates it well.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report visible reduction in redness and pimple size overnight; one reviewer reports it worsened redness and irritation on an old scar, and another says it made zits more red.
concerns.barrier: A minority describe burning, stinging, or a strong alcohol smell causing facial burning; most others report no irritation and describe it as gentle once dried.
concerns.spots: The large majority report individual spots, whiteheads and surface pimples visibly shrink or disappear overnight or within a few days; a few report no visible change at all.
concerns.blemishes: Numerous reviewers with cystic or hormonal blemishes on the chin, jawline and neck report reduced size and faster healing over several days; some state it does not work on cystic or under-the-skin blemishes at all.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with combination/oily skin reports it does not leave the face oily in the morning; otherwise oiliness itself is not a frequently discussed outcome.

extraits.titre: Tried and true, repurchased several times
extraits.texte: I deal with cystic acne, which means it never comes to a head. This drying lotion has been my go to spot teatment for years now. I may have to use it 1-3x in a row for the acne to be completly gone, but it always works for me.

Works well and fast. I would recommend this for more stubborn or fresh breakouts, because it is also very strong (drying). Once the breakout starts to calm down, it might be good to switch to regular Calamine lotion. I found too much use of the Badescu can trigger skin irritation due to its strength. Note: I have sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: I have rebought this product so many times!!!
extraits.texte: This product is my go to when i have really oily skin and get whiteheads, it helps so much!! I am 11 years old and received this for my 10th birthday and have been using it ever since! Love it sm

Im 37 and been struggling with hormonal acne- primarily on my chin, jawline and neck- for the past year. After trying dozens of products that didn't work, i decided to try a sulfur based treatment. After applying my serums, I use the cloudburst moisturizer by Earth Harbor, and then I use this drying lotion on my trouble zones every night as the final step. After about a week of this routine, my acne has cleared up soooo much! I still get a tiny bit of congestion on my jawline, but this has reduction pimple flare ups more than anything id previously tried. This is a great product! Kate Summerville also makes a product like this, but the ingredients are almost identical, and this is half the price. Im already on my 2nd bottle.

I've been using this for years. I have dry, mature skin but still suffer from occasional break outs. This Mario Bandescu drying lotion is the best magic potion. I did order long handled swabs, to easily get the product out, as regular Qtips are a bit short. Blemishes are dried up, and soothed by the calamine lotion in the formula. I've even used it on mosquito bites! I've purchased it at least 6 times.

It's not over drying I use it for spot treatment but like every night almost lol I love it it doesn't leave my face super oily in the morning and I have combo acne phone skin and helps with the pimples that are deep under and I have thick skin
It ONLY worked on my dry spots on my face. It did reduce the redness but then I tried it on an old scar/wound because i had a flare up and the scar came right back with the inflammation.
